gridNote: mask grid 2048x2048, downsampled 2x from the heightmap; pixel centres map by worldX = minX+(px+0.5)*(maxX-minX)/width, worldY = maxY-(py+0.5)*(maxY-minY)/height
waterLevelNote: this level has no heights below zero, so the whole map is land; rivers above sea level are NOT water by this criterion
